
## Oxide GPUI (preview)

The same client drawn with GPUI, for trying it out: `Oxide-gpui-{{VERSION}}-<system>-<arch>` below.
- **Windows (ARM64):** `Oxide-gpui-{{VERSION}}-windows-arm64.zip`, holding `Oxide.exe`: nothing to install. SmartScreen asks for confirmation (More info › Run anyway).
- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** `Oxide-gpui-{{VERSION}}-macos-arm64.zip`, holding `Oxide.app` (shown as Oxide GPUI): unzip it elsewhere than the Oxide above, or it replaces it in Applications. Allow it the same way.
